prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1447; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported at an intersection in Baytown, Texas. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright. I'm not comfortable giving my full name on tape yet.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were driving before the collision?

A: I was heading east on the main road toward the shopping center. I'd been on that road maybe ten minutes.

Q: What was the traffic signal showing when you approached the intersection?

A: It was green for me. I'm pretty sure of that. I was going the speed limit, maybe a little under.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. It came out from the cross street on my right side. I hit the brakes but there wasn't time.

Q: Where did your vehicle make contact with the other car?

A: On the driver's side door, behind the front wheel. Their front end hit my side.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yeah, my lower back. It's sore and stiff, especially when I get up from a chair. I went to urgent care that same afternoon and they said it was a muscle strain.

Q: Have you received any treatment since then?

A: I've been doing physical therapy twice a week and taking anti-inflammatories. The doctor said it could take several weeks to improve.

Q: Did you have any passengers in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your account?

A: Just that I'm willing to share the photos I took at the scene. I think they show the damage pretty clearly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
